name: StdVoteBot
description: High-performance Telegram Voting and Poll Bot built in Go with MongoDB persistence, real-time live button updates, inline sharing, and anti-cheat protection.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram Numeric User ID of the Owner/Admin

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB Connection URI (MongoDB Atlas or standalone)

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Channel username to force users to join before voting (without @)

LOG_CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel ID for audit logs (optional, e.g. -1001234567890)
